<user_query>
@chat/apps/shared/src/tools/display-chart.ts:89 wjats the diff between ChartInputSchema and BaseInputSchema
</user_query>

`ChartInputSchema` is the strict chart-only schema. `BaseInputSchema` is a loose union shape used for tool input, then refined by `InputSchema`.

| | **ChartInputSchema** | **BaseInputSchema** |
|---|---|---|
| **Purpose** | Validate a chart | Accept either chart or table, then refine |
| **`chart_type`** | Chart types only (`bar`, `line`, …) | Charts **+** `"table"` |
| **`x_axis_key` / `x_axis_type` / `series` / `title`** | Required | Optional |
| **`y_axis_min` / `y_axis_max` / `show_data_labels`** | Present (y bounds refined) | Absent |
| **`conditional_formats`** | Absent | Optional (for tables) |

`InputSchema` uses `BaseInputSchema` as the outer shape, then `superRefine`s into either `ChartInputSchema` or `TableInputSchema` depending on `chart_type`.
